title: Mask composite fills the hole in an edge-band mask - server route defaults fillHoles ON
description:
USER-REPORTED 2026-08-04 with a live repro: an EDGE-BAND mask composite brings through the whole disc instead of just the band. Expected only the ring the mask selects; got the enclosed interior too.

ROOT CAUSE, found in one hop and NOT a guess: services/imageComposite.js compositeThroughMask() runs `if (fillHoles !== false) fillMaskHoles(maskRaw, width, height)`. routes/projects.js documents the parameter as "optional, default true: areas enclosed by paint count as masked, matching MaskDetailerPipe contour_fill". Grepped every consumer 2026-08-04: NOBODY EVER PASSES IT. It is undefined at every call site, `undefined !== false` is true, and hole filling is unconditionally ON. A ring mask is a disc before Sharp ever sees it.

THIS IS THE MPI-431 TWIN ITS SWEEP MISSED. That card turned mask_fill_holes OFF in every raw template and the detailers contour_fill with it, for exactly this reason (the graph silently refilled an edge band into a disc before the sampler saw it), and established that THE APP IS NOW THE ONLY THING THAT CLOSES A HOLE - via the Fill button, where the user can see it happen. That sweep covered the graph; this server route kept its own private copy of the behaviour, on by default. Read MPI-431 first: docs/masking-tools.md and tasks/MPI-431/.

FIX DIRECTION (settle before coding): default fillHoles to FALSE so the route respects the mask it was handed, and let a caller opt in explicitly. That matches the MPI-431 ruling and the Fill button. Do NOT delete fillMaskHoles - it is correct code that may earn a real opt-in caller.

BLAST RADIUS - sweep, do not spot-fix:
- /project/composite-media (MPI-362, the shipped modal) is the reported consumer.
- /project/apply-paint uses compositeOverlay(), a DIFFERENT function that never calls fillMaskHoles - verified 2026-08-04, unaffected.
- MPI-373 (Composite, the last MPI-424 card) REPLACES the modal but explicitly keeps this same server route under BOTH its front ends. Fixed here, 373 inherits the fix; left alone, 373 inherits the bug behind a new UI where it is far harder to spot.

RELATED BUT DISTINCT: MaskManager.getURL() exports any non-zero alpha as solid white while the app cuts at >=128 elsewhere (measured in MPI-368 - docs/masking-shapes.md). That one promotes an antialiasing rim to mask; this one fills an enclosed region. Both are about what a mask MEANS by the time it leaves the app, so they are worth deciding in one sitting.
acceptance: An EDGE-BAND mask composites as a BAND - the enclosed interior keeps the base image, verified on the user repro (composite of a ring mask)
A mask with a genuine hole in it composites with that hole open
A solid mask is unchanged from today - the fix must not move the ordinary case
fillMaskHoles() still exists and still works when a caller opts in explicitly
Every consumer of compositeThroughMask swept and classified, not just the reported one
MPI-373 inherits the fixed route - no second copy of the behaviour behind the new UI
